basis: Severe MPS I defines skeletal and cognitive disease; cardiomyopathy and valve abnormalities 80-99%. Airway and corneal disease omitted by cap.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay define the syndrome; obesity 3/5 and dental abnormalities 30-79%. Major eye, ear and heart defects are occasional.
Retinal degeneration is shared by isolated retinitis pigmentosa and Bardet-Biedl subtypes; renal and metabolic disease are not shared across the umbrella.
FGFR1-related Pfeiffer syndrome is defined by craniosynostosis and characteristic thumb/toe skeletal abnormalities.
Defined by excess adrenal cortical hormone production; no other directly damaged organ is established across this umbrella.
Defined by excessive neonatal red-cell concentration; organ injury from hyperviscosity is not universal or defining.
Expressive language development or acquired language function is impaired; this falls within the neurodevelopmental axis.
Defined by phosphate metabolism disturbance, renal phosphate wasting and rickets; hearing loss 80-99%. Dental disease and malabsorption 30-79% omitted by cap.
Congenital sensorineural hearing impairment defines the disease.
Muscular dystrophy, early contractures and cardiac conduction disease define EDMD; cardiac abnormalities 30-79%. Lipid abnormalities may represent separate dyslipidemia.
Mycobacterial infection defines the umbrella; pulmonary, cutaneous and neural sites vary by subtype.
Defined by abnormal fibrillar material in anterior eye tissues; subsequent glaucoma remains within the ocular axis.
Serine biosynthesis deficiency with defining developmental impairment, seizures and cerebral abnormalities.
Defined by skin blistering; infectious, autoimmune and genetic mechanisms vary across subtypes.
Isolated sperm formation abnormality and male infertility; no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Congenital skeletal muscle disease defined by excess muscle spindles.
Definition identifies presumed autoimmune granulomatous inflammation. Testicular reproductive tissue has no anatomical axis; endocrine dysfunction is not established.
Inherited retinal dysplasia with falciform retinal folds; retinal disease belongs to the ocular axis.
Glycosylation defect with liver failure/cholestasis 2/2; short long bones 2/2 and renal agenesis/hydronephrosis 1/2. Cardiac defects 1/2 omitted by cap.
Lysosomal disorder with immunodeficiency and intellectual disability 80-99%; dysostosis 80-99%. Hearing loss and cataracts 30-79% omitted by cap.
Defined by neuromuscular junction dysfunction. Weakness, ptosis and respiratory insufficiency reflect impaired transmission; recurrent infections are separate complications.
Defined by developmental impairment and epileptic encephalopathy; no independent metabolic disorder is established.
Selective marrow erythroid hypoplasia causes anemia and reticulocytopenia; immune mechanisms are not shared by all subtypes.
Developmental and skeletal abnormalities define CSS3; hearing impairment 3/4 and visual impairment 2/3. Oral clefts 2/4 and hair abnormalities omitted by cap.
Hereditary motor neuropathy with neuropathic EMG and areflexia; muscle weakness and atrophy result from denervation.
